# What’s New In Python 3.12[¶](#what-s-new-in-python-3-12 "Link to this heading")
## Deprecated[¶](#deprecated "Link to this heading")

    See [**PEP 688**](https://peps.python.org/pep-0688/#current-options) for more details. (Contributed by Shantanu Jain in [gh-91896](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/91896).) * [`datetime`](../library/datetime.html#module-datetime "datetime: Basic date and time types."): [`datetime.datetime`](../library/datetime.html#datetime.datetime "datetime.datetime")’s [`utcnow()`](../library/datetime.html#datetime.datetime.utcnow "datetime.datetime.utcnow") and [`utcfromtimestamp()`](../library/datetime.html#datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp "datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp") are deprecated and will be removed in a future version.

# What’s New In Python 3.12[¶](#what-s-new-in-python-3-12 "Link to this heading")
## Deprecated[¶](#deprecated "Link to this heading")
### Pending removal in future versions[¶](#pending-removal-in-future-versions "Link to this heading")

    + [`utcnow()`](../library/datetime.html#datetime.datetime.utcnow "datetime.datetime.utcnow"): use `datetime.datetime.now(tz=datetime.UTC)`.
  + [`utcfromtimestamp()`](../library/datetime.html#datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp "datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp"): use `datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp,tz=datetime.UTC)`.
* [`gettext`](../library/gettext.html#module-gettext "gettext: Multilingual internationalization services."): Plural value must be an integer.
* [`importlib`](../library/importlib.html#module-importlib "importlib: The implementation of the import machinery."):

# `datetime` — Basic date and time types[¶](#module-datetime "Link to this heading")
## `datetime` objects[¶](#datetime-objects "Link to this heading")
*classmethod* datetime.now(*tz=None*)[¶](#datetime.datetime.now "Link to this definition")

    This function is preferred over [`today()`](#datetime.datetime.today "datetime.datetime.today") and [`utcnow()`](#datetime.datetime.utcnow "datetime.datetime.utcnow").

# `datetime` — Basic date and time types[¶](#module-datetime "Link to this heading")
## `datetime` objects[¶](#datetime-objects "Link to this heading")
*classmethod* datetime.utcnow()[¶](#datetime.datetime.utcnow "Link to this definition")

    :   Return the current UTC date and time, with [`tzinfo`](#datetime.datetime.tzinfo "datetime.datetime.tzinfo") `None`.

# `datetime` — Basic date and time types[¶](#module-datetime "Link to this heading")
## `datetime` objects[¶](#datetime-objects "Link to this heading")
*classmethod* datetime.utcnow()[¶](#datetime.datetime.utcnow "Link to this definition")

    This is like [`now()`](#datetime.datetime.now "datetime.datetime.now"), but returns the current UTC date and time, as a naive [`datetime`](#datetime.datetime "datetime.datetime") object. An aware current UTC datetime can be obtained by calling `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`. See also `now()`.

# `datetime` — Basic date and time types[¶](#module-datetime "Link to this heading")
## `datetime` objects[¶](#datetime-objects "Link to this heading")
*classmethod* datetime.utcnow()[¶](#datetime.datetime.utcnow "Link to this definition")

    Deprecated since version 3.12: Use [`datetime.now()`](#datetime.datetime.now "datetime.datetime.now") with [`UTC`](#datetime.UTC "datetime.UTC") instead.

# `datetime` — Basic date and time types[¶](#module-datetime "Link to this heading")
## `datetime` objects[¶](#datetime-objects "Link to this heading")
*classmethod* datetime.utcfromtimestamp(*timestamp*)[¶](#datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp "Link to this definition")

    Deprecated since version 3.12: Use [`datetime.fromtimestamp()`](#datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp "datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp") with [`UTC`](#datetime.UTC "datetime.UTC") instead.

# Deprecations[¶](#deprecations "Link to this heading")
## Pending removal in future versions[¶](#pending-removal-in-future-versions "Link to this heading")

    + [`utcnow()`](../library/datetime.html#datetime.datetime.utcnow "datetime.datetime.utcnow"): use `datetime.datetime.now(tz=datetime.UTC)`.
  + [`utcfromtimestamp()`](../library/datetime.html#datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp "datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp"): use `datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp,tz=datetime.UTC)`.
* [`gettext`](../library/gettext.html#module-gettext "gettext: Multilingual internationalization services."): Plural value must be an integer.
